summary: Repeated power cuts and line faults, unpaved and waterlogged lanes in Tanda, and complaints about Swar CHC dominate voter concerns, while the sanctioned seven-road budget and CHC heart-attack injection stock are the main appreciated items.

positives.english: The life-saving heart attack injection is now available at Swar CHC
positives.hindi: स्वार सीएचसी पर हार्ट अटैक का जीवनरक्षक इंजेक्शन मिलने लगा है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala 30 Aug 2026 (Rampur dateline): five tenecteplase injections kept at each of five CHCs (Swar, Bilaspur, Shahabad, Milak, Tanda) for emergencies; CMO Dr Deepa Singh says timely treatment is meant for the golden hour; Meerut expert team decides on use after ECG

positives.english: Rs 7.9 crore has been sanctioned for seven roads in Swar
positives.hindi: स्वार की सात सड़कों के लिए 7.9 करोड़ रुपये मंजूर हुए हैं
positives.basis: Amar Ujala 4 Apr 2026 (Swar dateline): about Rs 7.9 crore approved for seven works in Swar constituency, via PWD under the Economic Development Scheme; MLA Shafiq Ahmad Ansari confirms the sanction; article says work will start soon, not begun. Approval stage only, not a completed or started project

positives.english: Power came back after ten hours, and that was a relief
positives.hindi: 10 घंटे बाद बिजली आई, चलो राहत मिली
positives.basis: Amar Ujala 20 Aug 2026 (Swar dateline): 33 kV line fault from Tanda repaired and Swar town supply fully restored around 11:30 AM Wednesday; article says people breathed a sigh of relief when power returned. Restoration of a fault, not a new supply

positives.english: Ayushman cards being made are giving patients support for treatment
positives.hindi: आयुष्मान कार्ड बनने से मरीजों को इलाज का सहारा मिल रहा है
positives.basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Mediasaheb 11 Oct 2026: 1,79,000 Ayushman cards made in past year, 6,91,928 in total, Rampur ranked first in UP per the report; Swar and Tanda tehsil beneficiaries named, no AC card count given

positives.english: Inference: If the roads are built, travel between villages will become easier
positives.hindi: *सड़कें बनीं तो गांवों का आना-जाना आसान होगा
positives.basis: Inference: no completed road or other delivered project in Swar was found in sources; this rests on the sanctioned seven-road budget (rank 2), which has not started. Forecast, not appreciation; flagged for field check

negatives.english: Constant power cuts in villages hurt farmers and traders
negatives.hindi: गांवों में लगातार बिजली कटौती से किसान और व्यापारी परेशान हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala 20 Sep 2026 (Moradabad bureau, Swar tehsil): BKU Lok Shakti dharna at Swar tehsil power house; memorandum to JE (Rural) Shyam Singh; demands at least 18 hours rural supply, new independent substation for Khempur and Narpatnagar, connecting Rajnagar and Pusvada feeders to Swar rural substation, survey of overloaded feeders. Quote: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में लगातार बिजली कटौती से किसान, व्यापारी, विद्यार्थी और आम उपभोक्ता परेशान हैं. AC membership unconfirmed for rural feeders, Khempur and Narpatnagar (Narpatnagar is a nagar panchayat not in the AC extent); not counted in ac_specific_negatives

negatives.english: The power line kept breaking down in Swar, and the lights were out for ten hours
negatives.hindi: स्वार में बिजली की लाइन बार-बार खराब हुई, दस घंटे बत्ती गुल रही
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala 20 Aug 2026 (Swar dateline): 33 kV line from Tanda faulted; Swar town and nearby areas without power about ten hours; SDO Hari Deepak Yadav cites continuous overnight breakdowns; Rasulpur feeder also faulted. Swar town is in the AC (Swar MB)

negatives.english: In Tanda Hurmatnagar there are unpaved lanes, waterlogging, and no water from the taps
negatives.hindi: टांडा हुरमतनगर में कच्चे रास्ते, जलभराव और नल में पानी नहीं आता
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala 27 Mar 2026 (Bilaspur dateline, Moradabad bureau): Ward 23 of Tanda Hurmat Nagar mohalla, about 6,000 residents; unpaved roads and rain waterlogging; pipeline laid about ten years ago has brought no water; councillor Shaheen Jahan and EO Dr Nitin Kumar Gangwar quoted. AC membership: Tanda MB is in the AC extent per Wikipedia

negatives.english: We have complaints about the arrangements at Swar CHC
negatives.hindi: स्वार सीएचसी की व्यवस्था से शिकायत है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala 6 Apr 2026: MLA's son Umar Ansari inspected Swar CHC after complaints about hospital arrangements and sat in the in-charge's chair; CMO Dr Deepa Singh formed an inquiry team; article reports no findings yet. Allegations only. Swar CHC is in Swar town (AC)

negatives.english: Allegedly, pumping water out of the underpass is damaging crops and raising flood risk
negatives.hindi: अंडरपास का पानी निकालने से फसल खराब और बाढ़ का खतरा, आरोप है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala 25 May 2026 (Kamri dateline): Swar Khurd villagers protested again at a railway underpass site; seven or eight pumps running continuously allegedly harm crops and lower well water and raise flood risk; no official response in article. AC membership unconfirmed: Swar Khurd is near Kamri, which is not in the AC extent; not counted in ac_specific_negatives

notes: Identity: Wikipedia lists the AC as Swar (also Suar), No. 34, Rampur district, no reservation, Hindi name स्वार. Extent per Wikipedia: KCs Tanda and Swar, Forest Rudarapur range, Swar MB, Tanda MB, Maswasi NP, all within Swar tehsil. Positives remain thin: the CHC injection stock is the only delivered AC-specific benefit. Positive 2 is an approval, not started. Positive 4 is district-level. Positive 5 is an inference forecast; no completed local project was found to replace it. Searches for completed Swar roads, bridges, CHC equipment, and Tanda water tanks or substations in 2026 found nothing usable. Negative 1 rural feeders and Khempur/Narpatnagar membership unconfirmed; negative 5 (Swar Khurd, Kamri area) membership unconfirmed. Maswasi NP has no recent local item found. Other Rampur places found in searches (Patwai, Shahabad, Saifni, Milak, Bilaspur, Rampur HP) were excluded as outside the AC. Field check suggested for Tanda Hurmatnagar ward membership, Swar rural feeders, the Swar Khurd underpass, and the status of the seven Swar roads. P2 weak positive: approval stage only, work not started. P5 weak positive: forecast from a sanctioned road budget that has not started; flagged for field check.

round2.changes: Verified all 9 article URLs and the Wikipedia identity page by opening them (all www.amarujala.com or mediasaheb.com, no mirrors). Corrected P1 basis (five CHCs, five injections each); P2 basis now states approval only; P3 basis notes it is a restoration; P4 flagged district-level; P5 flagged as forecast; N1 membership caveat made specific (Narpatnagar outside AC extent); N3 Hindi shortened to 12 words and councillor spelling corrected to article; N4 basis states allegations only; N5 membership caveat and Kamri-dateline noted, not counted. Searched for replacement positives (completed roads, CHC equipment, water tank, substation) and found no AC-specific completed project; P2 and P5 kept as flagged.
